frase_gancho.texto: The city’s largest mountain, its sacred cave, and its treasures.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: In the heart of the Calzada stands the Pyramid of the Sun, an artificial mountain built in a single effort over a tunnel shaped like a four-petaled flower. In its shadow lived the priests who tended its worship, in a compound decorated with the blue jaguar mural. And right on the south side of the pyramid stands the Museum of Teotihuacán Culture, an essential stop for viewing the great model of the city and the original offerings recovered from beneath the pyramids.
